findings.what: The page opens with English index names and 'מדד' in a stock sense; an older saver would think it's not for her and leave
Nothing says that the money can go down; the 7% looks like a promise
The cheapest option is a company I've never heard of, and the page doesn't say who is behind the site
The fund name is hidden behind the floating arrow button
Fee colours (yellow/orange, red/pink) are too close to tell apart
Small grey text on a dark background is hard to read even enlarged
A long list with two numbers per row is overwhelming
A minus sign next to the second option is alarming without explanation
